verdict.rationale: Segment's docs and catalog show hundreds of documented, named destinations (Algolia, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, etc.) delivered via the Actions framework, which is built around per-destination field mapping, plus Functions for building custom destinations and a Public API for managing Destinations/Sources programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of destination-level event/property filtering controls and independent confirmation of mapping UI depth beyond the catalog listing.
